title: Helping Tonight Show bands with the acts he writes for
summary: Jones goes to the studio with John Levy's acts such as Joe Williams and Shirley Horn to help rehearse the band.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: He liked strings but he did not ever seem to write for them. So, the Tonight Show, with Skitch Henderson, NBC, I see here.
Yeah. Well, I'll tell you, let me explain that some. I was working for -- with John Levy's act.
And with Joe Williams, Shirley Horn -- who else? A couple of other acts that I had been doing albums with, and I would go over to the studio with them.
-- help rehearse the band and explain some things.
Well, you still do that with Joe Williams,
when he does the Tonight Show here.
